name: Cannalicious Live Resin | GMO Cookies
description: GMO Cookies is a potent indica-dominant hybrid created by crossing Girl Scout Cookies with Chemdawg. Known for its pungent aroma of garlic, diesel, and earth, it delivers a powerful, long-lasting high that combines deep body relaxation with a euphoric, hazy mental state. Ideal for evening use, GMO Cookies is a go-to for stress relief, pain management, and unwinding after a long day.
